framework.name: Dioxus
framework.renderer: HTML/CSS through browser or system WebView
framework.dependencyPolicy: Direct dependencies use exact versions; Cargo.lock records the full resolution.
framework.resolvedComponents: The Dioxus 0.7.0 facade resolved compatible 0.7.10 renderer components.

hostTests.detail: 2 targeted tests passed: deterministic semantic HTML and report-schema coverage.

webCompile.detail: Dioxus web binary compiled and produced a frozen release bundle for wasm32-unknown-unknown.

desktopCompile.detail: Dioxus produced a frozen unsigned macOS release bundle and registered a running process with Launch Services.
desktopCompile.command: .tools/bin/dx build --macos -p paseo-ui-renderer-pilot --bin paseo-ui-desktop --no-default-features --features desktop --bundle macos --release --codesign false --frozen

iosCompile.detail: aarch64-apple-ios target exists, but objc2-exception-helper could not locate the iphoneos SDK through xcrun.

androidCompile.detail: Dioxus mobile binary compiled for aarch64-linux-android with NDK 27.1 and API 35 linker.

launch.detail: Release browser and Android AVD runtimes launched with touch-state transitions. A frozen macOS release process registered and remained alive without capturable window evidence; other hosts remain unproven.

visual.detail: Pinned original and Rust open-project screenshots exist at desktop and mobile viewports. RMSE is 0.0464723 and 0.0776069, so no visual threshold passes.

accessibility.detail: SSR, browser, and Android runtime trees expose semantic navigation, buttons, status, names, and order; screen-reader behavior remains unproven.

native.detail: Pilot web, desktop, and mobile surfaces use HTML/CSS DOM or WebView renderers; platform-native widgets and experimental Dioxus Native were not implemented.

packaging.detail: A frozen browser release bundle, unsigned Android debug APK, and unsigned macOS release app exist. IPA, signed artifacts, installers, updates, and rollback remain unproven.

decision.reason: Browser and Android runtime evidence is partial. Pinned visuals differ, and assistive-technology behavior, iOS, Windows, Linux, native integration, and delivery remain unsupported or unproven.
